simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַלְאָכִי (H4401) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מַלְאָכִי (Malʼâkîy) means Malaki , a prophet First listed occurrence: Mal 1 1.

definitions.full: H4401. Malaki מַלְאָכִי apparently proper name, masculine Malachi , Mal 1:1 , but in fact not historical name of author, nor pseudonym for Ezra; probably a conjecture based on 3:1 ; so many moderns; see Dr Intr .
